_comment: Allowed licenses are a conservative team policy (permissive OSI licenses). The 2026 T&C require OSI-open or freely available third-party materials. Anything else needs team approval: add it to approvedExceptions with a reason.

approvedExceptions.name: lightningcss*
approvedExceptions.reason: Hard dependency of Vite 8 (and its per-platform binaries). Build-time only; not included in the shipped bundle. MPL-2.0 is OSI-approved, so within the 2026 Terms. We do not modify it.
approvedExceptions.approvedBy: team member, in chat with the assistant, 2026-11-14
